facts.text: Founded in 1963 in Fairfield, Connecticut, Sacred Heart University was the first Catholic university in America to be led and staffed by lay people.

sources.title: SHU Facts | Sacred Heart University
sources.quote: Founded in 1963 as a Catholic University by the Most Reverend Walter W. Curtis, Bishop of the Diocese of Bridgeport. The first Catholic University in America to be led and staffed by lay people.
